INTERNATIONAL COPPER STUDY GROUP 



**CNDR 09/11 9 September 2009 English Only** 

# **Note to the Designated Representatives of Member Countries** 

## **DOCUMENTS FOR THE ICSG MEETINGS IN LISBON, 5-7 OCTOBER 2009** 

Enclosed please find documents for the meetings of the Standing Committee, Environmental & Economic Committee and Statistical Committee as per the list attached, together with the Draft Program for the Joint Study Groups’ Seminar “Postcrisis metals: What will be different?” to be held on 7 October. 

Documents regarding the Forecast and the draft Press Release will be made available nearer to the time of the meetings. 

The schedule of meetings is as follows: 

## **Monday 5 October 2009** 

4.00-5.30pm ICSG Standing Committee (governments only) 

## **Tuesday 6 October 2009** 

10.45am-1.00pm ICSG Environmental & Economic Committee 

- 4.00-6.00pm ICSG Statistical Committee 

- 6.00pm ICSG/INSG Joint Cocktail/Reception 

## **Wednesday 7 October 2009** 

Morning Possible copper-related plant visit (to be confirmed) 2.00-5.30pm Joint Study Groups’ Seminar “Post-crisis metals: What will be different?” 

- 7.30pm-9.30pm Reception hosted by RBS Sempra Commodities 

____________________________________________________________________________ 

Rua Almirante Barroso, 38 - 6th floor, 1000-013 Lisbon, Portugal            Tel: +351-21-351-3870 email: mail@icsg.org                                                                                  Fax:+351-21-352-4035 

The ICSG meetings on 6-7 October will be held at the Headquarters of the ICSG, Main Conference Room, Ground Floor, 38 Rua Almirante Barroso, Lisbon (Metro Picoas or Saldanha on the yellow line). 

## **Joint Study Groups’ Seminar “Post-crisis metals: What will be different?”** 

All ICSG participants are invited to participate in the Joint Study Groups’ Seminar “Postcrisis metals: What will be different?” to be held at the Altis Hotel, 11 Rua Castilho, 1269-072 Lisbon, Tel: +351 21 310 60 22, from 2.00pm to 5.30pm on Wednesday 7 October, with a reception hosted by RBS Sempra Commodities to follow that evening (nearest Metro station is Marquкs de Pombal on the blue line). 

## **Joint Cocktail/Reception** 

All ICSG  participants are invited to the joint cocktail/reception that will follow the Joint Study Groups’ Seminar.  The Reception will be hosted by RBS Sempra Commodities, at Palбcio Sгo Vicente, Largo de Sгo Vicente 5, Graзa/Alfama, Lisbon, from 7.30pm to 9.30pm. 

(Buses will depart from the Altis Hotel at 7.00pm and return to the hotel by 9.45pm) 

Best regards 

Don Smale Secretary-General 

_____________________________________________________________________________ Rua Almirante Barroso, 38 - 6th floor, 1000-013 Lisbon, Portugal                Tel: +351-21-351-3870 email: mail@icsg.org                                                                                     Fax:+351-21-352-4035
